## Overview

This starter project describes a reusable workflow for choice modelling research, from raw survey data through model estimation and reporting.

## Research Question

How can a choice experiment workflow be structured so that data cleaning, model estimation, willingness-to-pay calculations, and reporting remain transparent and reproducible?

## Methods

- Define a clear data dictionary and survey structure.
- Prepare choice tasks and respondent-level covariates.
- Estimate baseline and heterogeneity-focused models.
- Report model fit, parameter signs, uncertainty, and willingness-to-pay measures.
